camera-space oriented geometric direction, host buffer xyz; not RGB/rendered normal

limitations: The observed images are training views of the frozen original model; view2 is held out from the local solver only. No GT reconstruction metric or Gaussian parameter backpropagation. Host warp_patch_ncc uses squared signed correlation and a 5e-6 variance gate, whereas this probe uses signed 1-ZNCC on grayscale with variance >1e-8; native, photo and joint are compared under this same probe metric. Local image derivatives are valid only inside the active bilinear cells; points within 1e-6 pixel of a cell edge are rejected. Implicit-solution derivatives with respect to recorded depths/weights remain unverified. The 32-ray denominator is retained; native view2-valid rays define a fixed common comparison set before either optimization, while unavailable costs remain null.
